Detailed Description

Optional contact-response parameter replacements for an unordered actor pair.

Each present field replaces the value normally combined from the two actors. An absent field retains the existing combination rule.

Note
Present fields have the same validity requirements as the corresponding ContactParams fields. A present zero is a value subject to those requirements, not an absent field.
